chapters.title: How we tried to break it

style: American English, spoken, second person plural 'we' for the investigation
hook in the first 45 words: a concrete contrast, no throat-clearing
one idea per sentence; no filler transitions; never repeat a fact to fill time
keep PROMISED / REPORTED / OBSERVED apart in every chapter
media/org claims contain their wording word (reported/said); hypotheses are hedged; limitations end with {L}
no 'proves', 'reveals', 'collapsed', 'cancelled', 'built' unless a claim explicitly allows it
explain US-specific references in a few words

C1.text: The Line was announced as a 170 km linear city.

C2.text: Bloomberg reported (Apr 2024) only about 2.4 km of The Line expected by 2030 and fewer than 300,000 residents.

C3.text: Semafor reported (22 May 2026) that NEOM halted work on The Line until at least after 2030, citing unnamed sources.

C4.text: Reuters reported (about 4 Oct 2026, two sources) that the NEOM stadium was shelved indefinitely, with no official announcement.

C9.text: A straight, narrow cleared corridor crosses the area, at least 15 km long inside our 10 m frame: absent in 2020-21, faint in 2022, clear from 2023.

C10.text: A dark segment is absent in Oct 2022 and 2023 and present in Oct 2024, 2025 and 2026: about 1.6 km long in 2024 and 2025 and about 1.9 km long in 2026, measured at 10 m.

C11.text: In 2024, 2025 and 2026 the dark segment is water-like in near-infrared (NDWI above zero, very low near-infrared); in 2022 and 2023 no pixel qualifies.

C12.text: Measured at 10 m, the segment is about 1.6 km long in Oct 2025 and about 1.9 km in Oct 2026; we cannot tell growth from water level or a threshold effect.

C13.text: Landsat 8 at 30 m shows the same segment but measures it differently: about 0.7 km in Oct 2024 (Sentinel-2: 1.6 km) and about 1.65 km in Oct 2025 and Sep 2026 (Sentinel-2: 1.6 and 1.9 km); the Landsat and Sentinel-2 scenes are two to three weeks apart.

C14.text: The segment appears on three different dates and on three different Sentinel-2 satellites (2A, 2B and 2C) in 2024, 2025 and 2026.

C15.text: Each pixel in our Sentinel-2 frames covers 10 meters of ground.

C16.text: Seven Sentinel-2 scenes, all from the same orbit, taken in late September or October of each year from 2020 to 2026.

C18.text: The dark segment may be standing water in a long, narrow excavation.

C17.text: A settlement-like complex at the western end of our frame grows from a small compound in 2020 to a large planned street grid by 2024; what it is is unknown.

C19.text: A second settlement-like complex at the eastern end of our frame grows from sparse tracks in 2020 to a planned street grid with buildings by 2024; what it is is unknown.

C20.text: The Line is part of NEOM, on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast.
